official_scoring_requires: all local schema and graph checks pass

primary_difficulty_metric.name: decision_field_level_macro_accuracy
primary_difficulty_metric.definition: For each question, score the 12 normalized factual decision-record fields. Average within each private level, then average the five level values with equal level weight.
primary_difficulty_metric.rationale: Equal level and field payloads make this stable and interpretable; full-record exact is too coarse for five-level calibration.

pilot20_acceptance.bootstrap_unit: match block with all five levels retained

stage_decisions.single_protocol_gate: Only protocol eligibility is evaluated; no difficulty conclusion is permitted.
stage_decisions.sentinel5: Screen target range and directionality; diagnose errors before changing data.
stage_decisions.pilot20: Estimate the frozen primary metric, level curve and bootstrap uncertainty.
stage_decisions.pre_220_freeze: Require a valid pilot20 run from two distinct strong-model families before expansion.

dataset_change_policy.primary_above_0_65: Increase only mechanisms associated with correctly answered items.
dataset_change_policy.primary_between_0_45_and_0_65_with_curve: Freeze difficulty and proceed to cross-family verification.
dataset_change_policy.primary_below_0_35_or_l1_below_0_60: Floor effect: do not add difficulty; reduce one burden dimension in L1/L2 or diagnose protocol.
dataset_change_policy.curve_inversion: Modify only inverted adjacent levels after error-taxonomy review.
dataset_change_policy.protocol_failure: Modify evaluation protocol only; do not change dataset difficulty.
